name: Florida Torreya
desc: Florida Torreya (Torreya taxifolia): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 113 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Torreya taxifolia, commonly known as Florida torreya or stinking-cedar, but also sometimes as Florida nutmeg or gopher wood, is an endangered coniferous subcanopy tree of the yew family, Taxaceae.
